errors.text_span: достига отчетлив максимум около ~250 при слой 19
errors.evidence: The peak value for the 'attn_output' (blue dashed) series at layer 19 is approximately 80-90, as seen on the chart where it is clearly below the 100 mark. The stated value of ~250 is a significant overestimation.
The value for the 'attn_residual' (orange dotted) series at layer 19 is approximately 20, not 150-160. The stated value is incorrect by a factor of 7-8.

errors.text_span: последван от стойности около ~120–150 при слоеве 20–22
errors.evidence: The values for the 'attn_residual' (orange dotted) series in this range are approximately 20 (layer 20), 50 (layer 21), and 100 (layer 22). The described range of 120-150 is incorrect for the entire interval.

The value for the 'ffn_residual' (red solid) series at layer 18 is approximately 180, not 150. The value is approximately 150 at layer 19, so the description misattributes the value to the wrong layer.

errors.text_span: zeigt um Layer 18–19 einen ausgeprägten Peak
errors.evidence: The description claims that the blue 'attn_output' line has a distinct peak around layers 18-19. However, the figure shows that the line rises to a local maximum at layer 18, then has a sharp dip (a local minimum) at layer 19, before rising again. Describing this dip as a peak is factually incorrect.
